summary: Three independent persona observers (new-user, active-user, churned-user) ran 14 scenarios end-to-end against dist/. 11/14 raw scenarios green; the 3 misses were diagnosed as persona-harness ordering/timing artifacts (post-goto localStorage seeding, missing waitFor before Enter) — all asserted green by the spec suite (gate-test PASS, 17/17). 0 critical, 0 warning, 9 suggestions (3× harness-fix + 6× v1.0.1 polish: aria-pressed on theme toggle, role=radiogroup on view-mode, search-from-404, contenteditable guard, etc). Tier baseline coverage 13/13 delightful.
